soft-rust-scotland.intent: Soft Rust by Daniel J. Schwarz: autumnal travel and winter-haze interpretation. Classic Negative, DR400, strong small grain, Color +4 and R+6/B-6 produce warm rust/ochre subjects against subdued cyan-grey water, haze and shadows. Avoid replacing a general-purpose portrait slot.
